method: Hermetic fixture indexed with the real indexer; taint flows seeded into brain_taint_flow, then the engines under test are compared against independent SQL derivations (JOIN resolution, aggregate re-derivation, comparator-ordered oracle). Latency itself is measured by the probes (probe-complexity-phases.ts, probe-security-phases.ts, probe-pattern-phases.ts) and the A2c production-shape sweep — never by a ceiling in this gate.
